title: BadQubits: An LLM-Based Framework for Static Pre-Execution Detection of Structurally Harmful Quantum Circuits
abstract: arXiv:2609.18965v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper presents BadQubits, an LLM-based framework for static pre-execution detection of structurally harmful OpenQASM 2.0 circuits. The framework targets physical-execution-layer threats by analyzing submitted circuits prior to runtime, where dynamic inspection is constrained by measurement irreversibility and the exponential cost of classical quantum-state simulation. We evaluate four code-understanding LLM architectures on a dataset of 1,500 circuits consisting of 1,000 benign programs from MQTBench[33] and 500 synthetic attack circuits derived from three documented physical-layer threat primitives. Our fine-tuned Qwen Coder 2.5 7B model achieves 92.67% classification accuracy and 96.1% harmful-circuit recall. Two of the four evaluated base models fail to generalize under constrained LoRA fine-tuning, indicating that architecture-aware model selection is a necessary design consideration rather than a minor tuning choice. translated_title: BadQubits：一种基于大语言模型的结构性有害量子电路执行前静态检测框架
translated_abstract: 本文提出了BadQubits，一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的框架，用于对结构性有害的OpenQASM 2.0电路进行执行前的静态检测。该框架针对物理执行层威胁，通过在运行之前分析提交的电路来发挥作用——在这一阶段，动态检测受限于量子测量的不可逆性以及经典量子态模拟的指数级计算成本。我们在一个包含1,500个电路的数据集上评估了四种代码理解型大语言模型架构，该数据集由来自MQTBench的1,000个良性程序和基于三种已有文献记录的物理层威胁原语生成的500个合成攻击电路组成。我们微调后的Qwen Coder 2.5 7B模型实现了92.67%的分类准确率和96.1%的有害电路召回率。四种被评估的基础模型中有两种在受限的LoRA微调条件下无法泛化，这表明基于架构特性的模型选择是一项必要的设计考量，而非次要的调参选择。
tldr: BadQubits提出了一个基于大语言模型的框架，可在量子电路执行前静态检测结构性有害电路，其微调后的Qwen Coder 2.5 7B模型达到92.67%的分类准确率和96.1%的有害电路召回率，并揭示了模型架构选择是关键设计考量。
en_tdlr: BadQubits presents an LLM-based framework for static pre-execution detection of structurally harmful quantum circuits, where the fine-tuned Qwen Coder 2.5 7B model achieves 92.67% accuracy and 96.1% harmful-circuit recall, demonstrating that architecture-aware model selection is a critical design consideration.
